headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal eye move for Brugge's Tresoldi
description: Arsenal are monitoring a possible move for Club Brugge striker Nicolò Tresoldi. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Ruben Amorim uninterested in contributing to Man United discourse: 'Nothing to say'
description: Ruben Amorim insisted he had "nothing to say" about Manchester United ahead of AC Milan's Europa League clash at Bournemouth on Thursday night.

headline: Who could replace Carrick after Man United's worst start since 1986?
description: Manchester United have struggled this season, but which managers could step in to replace Michael Carrick if the club sacks him?

headline: Trevoh Chalobah reveals Chelsea regret after £30m Como move
description: Trevoh Chalobah has revealed his regret at his Chelsea exit and admitted he wanted to be a "legend" at Stamford Bridge.

headline: Morgan Gibbs-White set to be fit for Nottingham Forest's clash with Ipswich
description: Morgan Gibbs-White will be back in contention for Nottingham Forest's game at Ipswich on Friday evening.

headline: Eli Junior Kroupi returns to Bournemouth training, could face Man United
description: Bournemouth have confirmed that Eli Junior Kroupi -- the club's top-scorer last season -- is back in training and could be in contention to face Manchester United on Sunday.
